title: Remote load behind a long wire
description: A 12V supply feeds a remote board through a wire with 5 ohm resistance. The netlist must contain exactly 'V1 vin 0 DC 12', 'Rwire vin remote 5', and the fixed load 'Rload vout 0 50'. Design a divider on the remote board (from 'remote' to 'vout' to ground) so that 'vout' is 5.00V +/-1%. Return a valid SPICE netlist.
